title: A new question reveals a condition

captions.physics: Revisiting an explanation request heard anew
captions.energy: Clarifying explanation tied to admitting error
captions.emotions: Feeling scope of questions and commitments

meaning: You can return to an explanation request heard anew and clarify an answer tied to admitting error, feeling the scope of question and commitment without accepting another conclusion in advance.
text: Judgement in the physical position of your Vishuddha appears in returning to an explanation request now heard differently. The Devil in energy supports honest clarification of an answer tied to prior admission of error. Justice in emotions brings a sense of a question’s scope and commitment. You can notice explaining a position and accepting another assessment have become one condition. Constructive energy makes this connection visible while preserving genuine choice.

For example, you return to “Explain why you disagree”. Interest in the argument becomes clear, but an expectation remains to begin “I was wrong”. **Explaining a position requires no advance acceptance of an argument’s conclusion**. You can name the condition and answer the actual question. Proportion emerges: an argument is heard without automatically adding an unnamed admission. Yet freedom to explain proves no correctness of the position itself; its substance can still be discussed without compulsory defeat beforehand.

Difficulty arises if this measure becomes a ban on admitting any inaccuracy. Freedom from one condition creates an opposite duty always to defend a reply. The constructive side of the Devil helps distinguish an imposed price from voluntary acknowledgement. You can explain freely and change your mind after a genuine argument; proportion requires neither prior concession nor forever abandoning “I was mistaken here” when that becomes an answer’s honest substance.
